messages:
Olivia: CI turned red on main, looks like a flaky in tests/runtime/test_batch_alignment.py::test_alignment_under_load — fails 1/3 runs on CI. job: https://ci.internal/3421 :frowning:
ci-bot: Build #3421 failed on linux-x86-64 (runner-3). Failing test output attached.
Olivia: failing assertion is `assert aligned == expected` with a 2ms delta bit off, stack shows scheduler sleep drift. snippet:
```
AssertionError: 0.0123 not within 0.01 of 0.0
  at tests/runtime/test_batch_alignment.py:87
  scheduler._sleep(0.01) returned 0.022 at t=1532.123
```
Chao: @Olivia thanks. Can you repro locally with the same CI job config?
Olivia: tried `./scripts/ci/run tests/runtime/test_batch_alignment.py::test_alignment_under_load --repeat 100 --seed 42` on my M1 and linux vm, passes every time. Can't repro locally.
Priya: looks like timer jitter interacting with the coalescer. We bumped the coalesce threshold in PR #4021 yesterday, might be related.
Jamie: pinging the PR owner — did PR 4021 touch the soft-timer path? @Chao any idea? :eyes: 
Chao: yes PR 4021 moved coalesce from 2ms -> 8ms to reduce wakeups. That can change ordering under high contention.
Olivia: rolled back the change locally, reran the test command, now passes repeatedly (100 runs). So likely regression.
Chao: can we bisect quickly? either revert or add deterministic clock in the test. Bisect plan: run CI with MAIN~1 and MAIN to confirm. I can trigger a bisect job.
Olivia: started a rerun with env `TEST_SCHEDULER_DETERMINISTIC=1` on CI: https://ci.internal/3423 — still failed (1/5).
Priya: failing still shows `scheduler._sleep` jitter ~10-20ms. Test assumes sub-10ms alignment, so it flaps. We should avoid relying on real-time in unit tests.
Jamie: Agreed. Quick fix: convert test to use fake clock / deterministic-timer harness. Longer fix: make coalescer preserve ordering guarantees for in-flight timers.
Olivia: I'll open a tiny PR that switches this test to the fake clock fixture and logs the seed. Patch will be minimal. Draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/4167 (WIP).
Chao: thanks — once PR is up, add a CI rerun and tag me. I'll run a focused bisect if needed.
ci-bot: Rerun #3423 complete: 5 runs, 2 failures (intermittent).
Priya: ok that matches a timing flake. If the fake-clock change passes CI consistently, let's merge and then follow up on the coalescer behavior.
Jamie: +1. Avoiding real timers in flaky unit tests is preferred.
Olivia: PR 4167 created and pushed the test change. Triggering CI on the PR now. cc @Chao @Priya
ci-bot: PR 4167 CI started; job link: https://ci.internal/4167/1
Olivia: thanks all, I'll monitor and revert the schedule change if CI still flakes after merge. :thumbsup:
